profile.name: Jenna Morales
profile.summary: Retail associate with 4 years on the sales floor of outdoor and workwear stores; at my best during holiday rushes.

descriptions: Serve 60–90 customers a shift, matching them with the right boots and gear; average customer satisfaction score of 4.8/5
Process sales, returns and exchanges on Lightspeed POS with zero cash variances in 2024
Fulfill buy online, pick up in store (BOPIS) and ship-from-store orders, about 40 a week in peak season
Signed up 300+ members to the rewards program, the top total in the district for Q4 2024
Unload weekly shipments of 50+ cartons and restock the floor before opening
Set new floor sets and window displays following visual merchandising guides
Train 3 seasonal hires each year and cover shifts for the team during the holiday rush
Took orders and handled the register during lunch rush (150+ orders a day)
